name: CITIZENS FINANCIAL GROUP INC/RI

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-12), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Capital expenditures, net': $174M for FY2025, with $122M for FY2024 and $172M for FY2023 in the same statement (all in $ millions; corroborated in EDGAR companyfacts under the tag PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssets, which the engine does not read, with identical values $174M/$122M/$172M)
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024 and FY2025 of the last 3 in EDGAR companyfacts under every candidate tag the engine reads (the filed values through FY2019 came via PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, $126M in FY2019; from FY2020 the filer presents capex only as the net line above). The engine applies this single FY2025 filing value to every missing period (FY2020-FY2025); for FY2023 it overstates true capex by $2M (true $172M) and for FY2024 by $52M (true $122M, ~2-3% of that year's conservative OE, in the conservative direction of lowering OE), and it likewise overstates FY2020-FY2022 (true net $118M/$124M/$126M on the same tag), none of which are in the last-3 median base except FY2023-FY2025. The figure is net of proceeds from sales of premises and equipment, whereas the pre-FY2020 filed values the engine used were gross — noted, not hidden; capex at this level is small next to OCF either way (FY2025 OCF $2,211M).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 2.9%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-12), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, investing activities line 'Capital expenditures, net': $174M for FY2025, with $122M for FY2024 and $172M for FY2023 in the same statement (all in $ millions; corroborated in EDGAR companyfacts under the tag PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssets, which the engine does not read, with identical values $174M/$122M/$172M)); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 5.0x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
